newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Lamont says sterling hitting competitiveness.
newsitem.headline: Lamont says sterling hitting competitiveness.

text.p: Northern Irish textiles group Lamont Holdings Plc said on Tuesday that the strength of sterling had impacted on the competitiveness of its products and those of its customers in key export markets.
But Lamont chairman Paul Vaight told shareholders at the group's annual meeting that the effect of sterling had been partly offset by savings in the costs of certain raw materials.

Vaight said Lamont had made good progress toward meeting its targets in the first four months of the year but said the benefits of performance improvement measures were likely to be weighted toward the second half.
He also said Lamont was negotiating the sale of the warehouse attached to the Shaw Carpets' factory with a number of interested parties and it expected a deal to be concluded in the near future.
